answer.script:
//@version=5
// How this script works
// The script builds a volume profile and uses the point of control (POC) and POC delta imbalance as directional context.
// It opens trades on a pivot-confirmed breakout (BOS) when a confirmed pivot is broken, subject to VWMA trend, confirmation-bar volume, and session/reduced-risk filters.
// The stop is a dollar stop from the stop_dollars input, with long_stop below price and short_stop above price, and the script also closes a position if open P&L reaches that stop.
// Exits also include a take-profit from tp_dollars, with optional trailing and reduced-risk stop/take-profit logic.
// The VWMA is used as a filter, not as the entry signal.

strategy("Day shift BOS Profitable 17k Delta Volume Breakout", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000, max_labels_count=500)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(50, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=1500)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250, maxval=2000)
use_trail         = input.bool(false, "Enable Trailing Stop")
trail_pct         = input.float(50, "Trail keep (%)", minval=0, maxval=100)
trail_step_amt    = input.int(500, "Trail: Tighten every ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
trail_step_pct    = input.float(50, "Trail step (%)", minval=0, maxval=100)
trail_min_dollars = input.int(1000, "Trail: Min Profit ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)

// ===== SESSION =====
use_session   = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr = input.int(8, "Session Start Hour (ET)")
sess_start_mn = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute")
sess_end_hr   = input.int(16,  "Session End Hour (ET)")
sess_end_mn   = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute")

// ===== REDUCED RISK =====
use_reduced_risk      = input.bool(true, "Use Reduced Risk Window", group="Reduced Risk")
reduced_start_hr      = input.int(12, "Start Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Reduced Risk")
reduced_start_mn      = input.int(0,  "Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Reduced Risk")
reduced_end_hr        = input.int(16, "End Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Reduced Risk")
reduced_end_mn        = input.int(0,  "End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Reduced Risk")
reduced_stop_dollars  = input.float(500.0, "Reduced Stop ($)", group="Reduced Risk")
reduced_tp_dollars    = input.float(450.0, "Reduced Take Profit ($)", group="Reduced Risk")

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
bar_t  = bar_hr * 100 + bar_mn
int s_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
int s_end   = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn

bool in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (bar_t >= s_start or bar_t < s_end) : (bar_t >= s_start and bar_t < s_end))

// Reduced risk window
int r_start = reduced_start_hr * 100 + reduced_start_mn
int r_end   = reduced_end_hr * 100 + reduced_end_mn
bool in_reduced = use_reduced_risk and (r_start > r_end ? (bar_t >= r_start or bar_t < r_end) : (bar_t >= r_start and bar_t < r_end))

float stop_pts = (in_reduced ? reduced_stop_dollars : stop_dollars) / pv
float tp_pts   = (in_reduced ? reduced_tp_dollars   : tp_dollars)   / pv

prev_hr = hour(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_mn = minute(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_t  = prev_hr * 100 + prev_mn
bool was_in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (prev_t >= s_start or prev_t < s_end) : (prev_t >= s_start and prev_t < s_end))
bool session_ended = was_in_session and not in_session

if session_ended and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Close")

long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_pts : close - stop_pts
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_pts : close + stop_pts
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv

if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_pts)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_pts * pv
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE =====
profile_lookback = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=2000, step=10)
profile_rows     = input.int(10, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=100, step=5, tooltip="More rows = finer resolution but slower.")

// ===== DELTA VOLUME =====
min_delta_pct = input.float(10.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5, tooltip="Net delta at POC must exceed this % of total POC volume to confirm direction. 0 = disabled.")

// ===== TREND FILTER =====
vwma_len       = input.int(50, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1)
vwma_slope_len = input.int(5, "VWMA Slope Lookback (bars)", minval=1)
min_slope      = input.float(0.0, "Min VWMA Slope (pts)", minval=0.0, tooltip="0 = disabled.")

// ===== ENTRY (Pivot confirmation) =====
pivot_left   = input.int(3, "Pivot Left Bars", minval=2, maxval=21, step=1, tooltip="Bars to left of pivot high/low.")
pivot_right  = input.int(3, "Pivot Right Bars", minval=2, maxval=21, step=1, tooltip="Bars to right - pivot confirmed when this many bars pass.")
disarm_only_inside_poc = input.bool(true, "Disarm Only When Back Inside POC", tooltip="If true, stay armed through pullbacks; only disarm when price fully re-enters POC zone.")
cooldown_bars = input.int(5, "Cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=100, step=1)

// ===== FILTERS =====
use_price_vwma  = input.bool(true, "Price vs VWMA", group="Filters", tooltip="Long: close above VWMA. Short: close below VWMA.")
vol_ma_len     = input.int(20, "Volume MA Length", minval=5, maxval=100, group="Filters")
use_vol_filter = input.bool(true, "High Volume on Confirmation", group="Filters", tooltip="Confirmation bar must have above-average volume.")

// ===== BREAKEVEN =====
use_breakeven      = input.bool(true, "Enable Breakeven Stop", group="Breakeven")
be_trigger_dollars = input.float(150.0, "BE Trigger ($)", minval=50, tooltip="Move stop to entry + 1 tick after this much unrealized profit.", group="Breakeven")
rev_on_any_loss    = input.bool(false, "Reverse on Any Loss (incl. BE)", group="Breakeven",
  tooltip="If true, reverse on ANY losing trade (including after BE triggered). If false, only reverse on full stop-outs where BE was never hit.")

// ===== COMPUTED =====
float be_trigger_pts = be_trigger_dollars / pv

// ===== VWMA TREND =====
float vwma_val   = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
float vwma_slope = vwma_val - vwma_val[vwma_slope_len]
bool  vwma_up    = min_slope <= 0 or vwma_slope > min_slope
bool  vwma_dn    = min_slope <= 0 or vwma_slope < -min_slope

// ===== VOLUME FILTER =====
float vol_ma    = ta.sma(volume, vol_ma_len)
bool high_vol   = volume >= vol_ma

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE WITH DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

// ===== BREAKOUT SIGNALS =====
bool above_poc = not na(poc_hi) and close > poc_hi and close[1] <= poc_hi
bool below_poc = not na(poc_lo) and close < poc_lo and close[1] >= poc_lo

bool delta_bull = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct)
bool delta_bear = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct)

// ===== PIVOT POINT CONFIRMATION =====
float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivot_left, pivot_right)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivot_left, pivot_right)


// ===== ARM ON POC BREAKOUT, ENTER ON PIVOT CONFIRMATION =====
var int armed_dir = 0

if above_poc and vwma_up and delta_bull
    armed_dir := 1
else if below_poc and vwma_dn and delta_bear
    armed_dir := -1

// Disarm: standard = any giveback; disarm_only_inside_poc = only when price fully back in POC zone
if armed_dir == 1 and not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo)
    if disarm_only_inside_poc
        if close <= poc_lo
            armed_dir := 0
    else if close <= poc_hi
        armed_dir := 0
else if armed_dir == -1 and not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo)
    if disarm_only_inside_poc
        if close >= poc_hi
            armed_dir := 0
    else if close >= poc_lo
        armed_dir := 0

// Pivot confirms: pivot high = new high established (long). Pivot low = new low established (short).
bool pivot_confirm_long  = armed_dir == 1 and not na(ph)
bool pivot_confirm_short = armed_dir == -1 and not na(pl)

// Apply filters
bool price_ok_long  = not use_price_vwma or close > vwma_val
bool price_ok_short = not use_price_vwma or close < vwma_val
bool vol_ok         = not use_vol_filter or high_vol

bool confirmed_long  = pivot_confirm_long and price_ok_long and vol_ok
bool confirmed_short = pivot_confirm_short and price_ok_short and vol_ok

var int last_trade_bar = -9999
bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars

bool long_sig  = confirmed_long and in_session and cooled_down and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = confirmed_short and in_session and cooled_down and strategy.position_size >= 0

// ===== ENTRIES =====
var float current_stop    = 0.0
var float entry_price     = 0.0
var float peak_profit_pts = 0.0
var bool  be_active       = false
var int   last_dir        = 0      // 1=long, -1=short
var bool  was_be_active   = false  // snapshot of be_active before reset
var bool  reversal_pending = false
var bool  is_reversal     = false  // true while in a reversal trade

float rev_stop_pts = stop_pts / 2.0
float rev_tp_pts   = stop_pts         // 2:1 RR on half risk

if long_sig
    current_stop    := close - stop_pts
    entry_price     := close
    peak_profit_pts := 0.0
    be_active       := false
    is_reversal     := false
    last_trade_bar  := bar_index
    last_dir        := 1
    armed_dir       := 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if short_sig
    current_stop    := close + stop_pts
    entry_price     := close
    peak_profit_pts := 0.0
    be_active       := false
    is_reversal     := false
    last_trade_bar  := bar_index
    last_dir        := -1
    armed_dir       := 0
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== RESET AFTER TRADE — detect full stop loss =====
if strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0
    was_be_active := be_active
    armed_dir       := 0
    peak_profit_pts := 0.0
    // Reverse on loss: either any loss (rev_on_any_loss) or only full stop (BE never hit)
    if not is_reversal and last_dir != 0
        bool loss_qualifies = rev_on_any_loss or not be_active
        if loss_qualifies
            int idx = strategy.closedtrades - 1
            if idx >= 0 and strategy.closedtrades.profit(idx) < 0
                reversal_pending := true
    be_active   := false
    is_reversal := false

// ===== REVERSAL TRADE — opposite direction, half risk, 2:1 RR =====
if reversal_pending and strategy.position_size == 0 and in_session
    reversal_pending := false
    is_reversal      := true
    peak_profit_pts  := 0.0
    be_active        := false
    last_trade_bar   := bar_index
    if last_dir == 1
        // Was long, got stopped → reverse short
        current_stop := close + rev_stop_pts
        entry_price  := close
        last_dir     := -1
        strategy.entry("RevShort", strategy.short)
        strategy.exit("XRS", "RevShort", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)
    else if last_dir == -1
        // Was short, got stopped → reverse long
        current_stop := close - rev_stop_pts
        entry_price  := close
        last_dir     := 1
        strategy.entry("RevLong", strategy.long)
        strategy.exit("XRL", "RevLong", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)

// ===== BREAKEVEN MANAGEMENT =====
if use_breakeven and strategy.position_size != 0 and not be_active
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        float unrealized_pts = close - entry_price
        if unrealized_pts >= be_trigger_pts
            be_active    := true
            current_stop := entry_price + 0.25
            strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
    else if strategy.position_size < 0
        float unrealized_pts = entry_price - close
        if unrealized_pts >= be_trigger_pts
            be_active    := true
            current_stop := entry_price - 0.25
            strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

if strategy.position_size == 0
    be_active := false

// ===== TRAILING STOP =====
if use_trail
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        float avg        = strategy.position_avg_price
        float profit_now = high - avg
        if profit_now > peak_profit_pts
            peak_profit_pts := profit_now
        if peak_profit_pts >= trail_min_dollars / pv
            float peak_dollars = peak_profit_pts * pv
            int   steps        = math.floor(peak_dollars / trail_step_amt)
            float keep_pct     = math.min(trail_pct + steps * trail_step_pct, 95.0)
            float new_stop     = avg + peak_profit_pts * (keep_pct / 100.0)
            if new_stop > current_stop
                current_stop := new_stop
                strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
    else if strategy.position_size < 0
        float avg        = strategy.position_avg_price
        float profit_now = avg - low
        if profit_now > peak_profit_pts
            peak_profit_pts := profit_now
        if peak_profit_pts >= trail_min_dollars / pv
            float peak_dollars = peak_profit_pts * pv
            int   steps        = math.floor(peak_dollars / trail_step_amt)
            float keep_pct     = math.min(trail_pct + steps * trail_step_pct, 95.0)
            float new_stop     = avg - peak_profit_pts * (keep_pct / 100.0)
            if new_stop < current_stop
                current_stop := new_stop
                strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== CRITERIA DISPLAY TABLE (NEVER REMOVE) =====
// Updated on every bar so it always stays rendered.
var table crit_table = table.new(position.top_right, 3, 11, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 70), border_width=1)

table.cell(crit_table, 0, 0, "Criterion", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 0, "Long", text_color=color.lime, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 0, "Short", text_color=color.red, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 1: POC Breakout
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 1, "POC Breakout", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 1, above_poc ? "1" : "0", text_color=above_poc ? color.lime : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 1, below_poc ? "1" : "0", text_color=below_poc ? color.red : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 2: VWMA Trend
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 2, "VWMA Slope (" + str.tostring(vwma_slope, "#.##") + ")", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 2, vwma_up ? "1" : "0", text_color=vwma_up ? color.lime : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 2, vwma_dn ? "1" : "0", text_color=vwma_dn ? color.red : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 3: Delta Imbalance
string delta_str = not na(poc_delta_pct) ? str.tostring(poc_delta_pct, "#.#") + "%" : "n/a"
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 3, "Delta (" + delta_str + ")", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 3, delta_bull ? "1" : "0", text_color=delta_bull ? color.lime : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 3, delta_bear ? "1" : "0", text_color=delta_bear ? color.red : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 4: Pivot Confirm
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 4, "Pivot Confirm", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 4, pivot_confirm_long ? "1" : "0", text_color=pivot_confirm_long ? color.lime : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 4, pivot_confirm_short ? "1" : "0", text_color=pivot_confirm_short ? color.red : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 5: Price vs VWMA
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 5, "Price vs VWMA", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 5, price_ok_long ? "1" : "0", text_color=price_ok_long ? color.lime : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 5, price_ok_short ? "1" : "0", text_color=price_ok_short ? color.red : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 6: Volume Filter
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 6, "High Volume", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 6, vol_ok ? "1" : "0", text_color=vol_ok ? color.lime : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 6, vol_ok ? "1" : "0", text_color=vol_ok ? color.red : color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 7: Armed direction
string armed_txt = armed_dir == 1 ? "LONG" : armed_dir == -1 ? "SHORT" : "---"
color armed_col = armed_dir == 1 ? color.lime : armed_dir == -1 ? color.red : color.gray
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 7, "Armed", text_color=color.yellow, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 7, armed_txt, text_color=armed_col, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 7, "", text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 8: Risk Mode
string risk_txt = in_reduced ? "REDUCED  SL=$" + str.tostring(reduced_stop_dollars, "#") + "  TP=$" + str.tostring(reduced_tp_dollars, "#") : "NORMAL  SL=$" + str.tostring(stop_dollars, "#") + "  TP=$" + str.tostring(tp_dollars, "#")
color risk_col = in_reduced ? color.orange : color.gray
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 8, "Risk Mode", text_color=color.white, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 8, risk_txt, text_color=risk_col, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 8, "", text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 9: Reversal
string rev_txt = is_reversal ? "ACTIVE" : reversal_pending ? "PENDING" : "---"
color rev_col = is_reversal ? color.orange : reversal_pending ? color.yellow : color.gray
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 9, "Reversal", text_color=color.orange, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 9, rev_txt, text_color=rev_col, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 9, "½R  2:1", text_color=color.gray, text_size=size.tiny)

// Row 10: Signal
string sig_txt = long_sig ? "LONG TRIGGERED" : short_sig ? "SHORT TRIGGERED" : "---"
color sig_col = long_sig ? color.lime : short_sig ? color.red : color.gray
table.cell(crit_table, 0, 10, "Signal", text_color=color.yellow, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 1, 10, sig_txt, text_color=sig_col, text_size=size.tiny)
table.cell(crit_table, 2, 10, "", text_size=size.tiny)

// ===== ENTRY LABELS WITH HOVER TOOLTIP (NEVER REMOVE) =====
if long_sig
    string tt = "LONG ENTRY\n" +
      "──────────────────\n" +
      (above_poc      ? "✓" : "✗") + "  POC breakout up\n" +
      (vwma_up        ? "✓" : "✗") + "  VWMA slope up  (" + str.tostring(vwma_slope, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
      (delta_bull     ? "✓" : "✗") + "  Delta bullish  (" + str.tostring(nz(poc_delta_pct), "#.#") + "%)\n" +
      (not na(ph)     ? "✓" : "✗") + "  Pivot high confirmed\n" +
      (price_ok_long  ? "✓" : "✗") + "  Price > VWMA  (" + str.tostring(close - vwma_val, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
      (vol_ok         ? "✓" : "✗") + "  High volume  (" + str.tostring(volume, "#") + " vs " + str.tostring(vol_ma, "#") + " avg)\n" +
      "──────────────────\n" +
      "Entry: " + str.tostring(close, "#.##")
    label.new(bar_index, low, "▲", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.lime, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, tooltip=tt)

if short_sig
    string tt = "SHORT ENTRY\n" +
      "──────────────────\n" +
      (below_poc       ? "✓" : "✗") + "  POC breakout down\n" +
      (vwma_dn         ? "✓" : "✗") + "  VWMA slope down  (" + str.tostring(vwma_slope, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
      (delta_bear      ? "✓" : "✗") + "  Delta bearish  (" + str.tostring(nz(poc_delta_pct), "#.#") + "%)\n" +
      (not na(pl)      ? "✓" : "✗") + "  Pivot low confirmed\n" +
      (price_ok_short  ? "✓" : "✗") + "  Price < VWMA  (" + str.tostring(close - vwma_val, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
      (vol_ok          ? "✓" : "✗") + "  High volume  (" + str.tostring(volume, "#") + " vs " + str.tostring(vol_ma, "#") + " avg)\n" +
      "──────────────────\n" +
      "Entry: " + str.tostring(close, "#.##")
    label.new(bar_index, high, "▼", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, tooltip=tt)

// Reversal entry labels
if is_reversal and strategy.position_size != 0 and strategy.position_size[1] == 0
    float rev_risk_d = rev_stop_pts * pv
    float rev_tp_d   = rev_tp_pts * pv
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        string tt = "REVERSAL LONG  (prev short stopped)\n" +
          "──────────────────\n" +
          "Half risk: $" + str.tostring(rev_risk_d, "#") + "  (" + str.tostring(rev_stop_pts, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
          "TP 2:1: $" + str.tostring(rev_tp_d, "#") + "  (" + str.tostring(rev_tp_pts, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
          "──────────────────\n" +
          "Entry: " + str.tostring(entry_price, "#.##") + "\n" +
          "Stop: " + str.tostring(entry_price - rev_stop_pts, "#.##") + "\n" +
          "TP: " + str.tostring(entry_price + rev_tp_pts, "#.##")
        label.new(bar_index, low, "▲R", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.orange, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, tooltip=tt)
    else if strategy.position_size < 0
        string tt = "REVERSAL SHORT  (prev long stopped)\n" +
          "──────────────────\n" +
          "Half risk: $" + str.tostring(rev_risk_d, "#") + "  (" + str.tostring(rev_stop_pts, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
          "TP 2:1: $" + str.tostring(rev_tp_d, "#") + "  (" + str.tostring(rev_tp_pts, "#.##") + " pts)\n" +
          "──────────────────\n" +
          "Entry: " + str.tostring(entry_price, "#.##") + "\n" +
          "Stop: " + str.tostring(entry_price + rev_stop_pts, "#.##") + "\n" +
          "TP: " + str.tostring(entry_price - rev_tp_pts, "#.##")
        label.new(bar_index, high, "▼R", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.orange, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, tooltip=tt)

// ===== POC DELTA FILL COLOR =====
color channel_fill = na
if not na(poc_delta_pct)
    float s = math.min(math.abs(poc_delta_pct) / 5.0, 1.0)
    if poc_delta_pct > 0
        channel_fill := color.new(color.green, 95 - math.round(s * 50))
    else if poc_delta_pct < 0
        channel_fill := color.new(color.red, 95 - math.round(s * 50))

// ===== POC DELTA LABEL (NEVER REMOVE) =====
var label lbl_delta = na
if not na(poc_price) and not na(poc_delta_pct)
    string dtxt = (poc_delta_pct >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(poc_delta_pct, "#.#") + "%"
    if na(lbl_delta)
        lbl_delta := label.new(bar_index, poc_price, dtxt, style=label.style_label_center, color=color.new(color.gray, 60), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
    else
        label.set_xy(lbl_delta, bar_index, poc_price)
        label.set_text(lbl_delta, dtxt)

// ===== PLOT =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", vwma_up ? color.lime : vwma_dn ? color.red : color.gray, linewidth=2)
float ppoc = not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na
float phi  = not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na
float plo  = not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na
plot(ppoc, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot_hi = plot(phi, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot_lo = plot(plo, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
fill(plot_lo, plot_hi, channel_fill)
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? current_stop : na, "Stop", color.fuchsia, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)

plot(not na(poc_delta_pct) ? poc_delta_pct : na, "POC Delta %", color.orange, display=display.data_window)
